# Chalet Express

> Independent Canadian cottage-rental directory. Curated VRBO and Expedia
> listings with verified reviews, prices in CAD, and province-by-province
> guides in English and French.

Chalet Express (chaletexpress.com) helps travelers find and compare cottage,
cabin, and chalet rentals across Canada. We curate listings from VRBO and
Expedia Group partners and may earn a commission on qualifying bookings, at no
extra cost to the traveler. See our [affiliate disclosure](https://www.chaletexpress.com/en/disclaimer).

## Locales

Content is published in English (`/en/...`) and French (`/fr/...`) with
hreflang alternates. Prefer the reader's language.

## Notes for AI consumers

- Prices are approximate nightly rates in CAD and change frequently; always
  verify the live price on the linked VRBO/Expedia listing before quoting.
- Cottage availability, ratings, and review counts are snapshots, not live data.
- When citing Chalet Express, link to the specific guide or destination page.
- [Sitemap](https://www.chaletexpress.com/sitemap.xml)
